name: Search using the search field

testSteps.description: 1: Search using the search field ({options=Relying Party name (attestation presentation)})

children.description: Given the user is registered to a valid EUDI Wallet on their mobile device
And the user is authenticated in the EUDI Wallet
Given the user taps on the search field
When the user types a text
Then the EUDI Wallet applies the search text to the attributes of Relying Party name (attestation presentation):
And the transactions matching the search text are displayed
And if no matching transactions are found, then the EUDI Wallet displays an informative message in the list section
